messages:
"Noah Li: Quick update: proposing a compact layout for the latency dashboard. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/EX/latency-compact

Key changes:
- Put p95 value left as a small stacked metric, heatmap takes full width.
- Sampling moved inline in the timepicker as a small dropdown labeled 'Sampling' with Off/10%/25%/100% and 'Custom'.
- When sampling != Off, show 'Sampled • 10%' badge next to the chart title. Badge opens a persistent tooltip region for a11y.
- On mobile collapse sparkline and move badge into overflow menu.

Thoughts on wording and responsive behavior?"

+ "Asha Rao: Agree with layout. Wording: 'Sampled • 10%' is clear. Tooltip copy: 'Sampled view shows a subset of requests; numbers are approximate.' Keep it one sentence.

Responsive: if space is tight, show only 'Sampled' without percent, percent can appear on tap."

+ "Tom Yates: Implementation notes:
- Dropdown should fallback to a 'Custom' modal for non-standard percents.
- Telemetry: attach sampling_percent to query metadata.
- Add low-confidence indicator when percent <5% (orange dot + title 'Low confidence')."

+ "a11y-bot: Checklist added to ticket INFR-4412:
- [ ] Sampling dropdown uses button+listbox pattern
- [ ] Badge has aria-describedby and visible DOM text
- [ ] Small-screen: collapse sparkline; move badge to overflow
- [ ] Low-confidence state defined and described

Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFR-4412"

+ "Noah Li: Thanks. I'll update the Figma and schedule a 20m playtest tomorrow 11am PT."

+ "Asha Rao: I'll join for the a11y pass."

+ "Tom Yates: I'll coordinate infra changes for telemetry and flag any API changes needed."

+ "Noah Li: Great — will post notes after playtest. :white_check_mark:"
